youtube.title: What happens if you fall into a black hole #Shorts
youtube.description:
Fall toward a black hole and watchers far away would see you slow down and freeze. NASA's simulation says the fall takes about three hours on your own clock, then seconds to spaghettification. Nobody has ever tested it, so the case file reads UNPROVEN.

#BlackHole #Space #Science #Shorts

tiktok.title: To everyone watching, you'd freeze at the edge of a black hole
